quote: The driver of a motor vehicle shall yield the right-of-way to any person riding a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter or a pedestrian as provided in subsection 6 of NRS 484B.297 [NRS-484B-297-6] on the pathway or lane. The driver of a motor vehicle shall not enter, stop, stand, park or drive within a pathway or lane provided for bicycles, electric bicycles or electric scooters except: (a) When entering or exiting an alley or driveway; (b) When operating or parking a disabled vehicle; (c) To avoid conflict with other traffic; (d) In the performance of official duties; (e) In compliance with the directions of a police officer; or (f) In an emergency.

activation.condition: Motor vehicle approaches a designated bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter pathway or lane used by a named road user, or enters its physical extent.

obligation.description: Yield the right-of-way to the enumerated pathway or lane user and avoid entering, stopping, standing, parking or driving within the designated facility unless a listed circumstance applies.

exceptions.trigger: When entering or exiting an alley or driveway
exceptions.effect: The designated-facility entry restriction has a listed circumstance; yield remains separately observed.
exceptions.source_clause: (a) When entering or exiting an alley or driveway

exceptions.trigger: When operating or parking a disabled vehicle
exceptions.effect: The designated-facility entry restriction has a listed circumstance, requiring source review of disability.
exceptions.source_clause: (b) When operating or parking a disabled vehicle

exceptions.trigger: To avoid conflict with other traffic
exceptions.effect: The designated-facility entry restriction has a listed circumstance, requiring source review of the conflict.
exceptions.source_clause: (c) To avoid conflict with other traffic

exceptions.trigger: In the performance of official duties
exceptions.effect: The designated-facility entry restriction has a listed circumstance, requiring source review of duties.
exceptions.source_clause: (d) In the performance of official duties

exceptions.trigger: In compliance with the directions of a police officer
exceptions.effect: The designated-facility entry restriction has a listed circumstance, requiring source review of the direction.
exceptions.source_clause: (e) In compliance with the directions of a police officer

exceptions.effect: The designated-facility entry restriction has a listed circumstance, requiring source review of emergency.

timing.description: During approach, precedence at the shared conflict region and full motor-vehicle body occupation of the designated facility.
